description:
The market brief behind a question such as 'Why did BTC drop 4%?': liquidations by
    window, funding extremes, open interest by venue, flows and risk zones for the coin, as one
    JSON for YOU to reason over. No language model runs on our side today, so `answer` is null and
    `brief` carries the facts (if a model is configured later, `answer` holds its short narrative).
    For a ready plain-words answer with no model, call ask.
